title: Network Engineer/ Administrator
description: Build What Matters at Model N At Model N, we help life sciences companies solve complex revenue challenges so they can operate smarter and bring important innovations to market faster. We are looking for people who like practical problem solving, cross-functional work, and seeing the impact of what they build. If you enjoy keeping networks fast, secure, and reliable for the people who depend on them, this could be a great fit. About the Role We are looking for a Network Engineer to join our Global Technology team in Hyderabad. In this role, you will install, configure, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain network infrastructure across corporate and cloud environments. You will work primarily on cloud networking, along with enterprise switching, firewalls, wireless infrastructure, and secure remote access technologies. You will work closely with senior engineers, IT teammates, cross functional teams, customers and vendors to ensure our network environment remains secure, reliable, and highly available. This role matters because our employees and customers depend on a fast, secure network to do their work, and reliable network engineering is what keeps everything connected. Key Responsibilities Configure, and maintain cloud network infrastructure, including AWS VPCs, subnets, route tables, Internet Gateways, NAT Gateways, Security Groups, NACLs, VPNs, Transit Gateway, and VPC Peering. Support and maintain enterprise switching infrastructure, primarily Cisco and Juniper switches, including VLANs, trunking, routing, and network connectivity. Support Palo Alto firewalls and Panorama, including firewall rule management, VPN connectivity, traffic analysis, and basic troubleshooting. Support Zscaler technologies, including Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), and troubleshoot connectivity and access-related issues. Support Aruba wireless infrastructure, including wireless connectivity, authentication, and troubleshooting. Monitor network performance and availability, and respond to alerts and incidents within agreed timelines. Troubleshoot network connectivity, routing, switching, DNS, latency, and security issues across corporate and cloud environments, and escalate complex problems to senior engineers when needed. Implement network changes through planned change requests, with documented configurations and rollback steps. Maintain network documentation, diagrams, and standard operating procedures, and share knowledge with the team. What Success Looks Like First 60 days Learn Model N's network architecture, monitoring tools, and change and incident processes. Build working relationships with senior network engineers, IT teammates, and vendors. Resolve assigned incidents and perform routine changes with guidance and peer review. First 3–6 months Handle routine incidents and planned changes independently, with few escalations. Improve network monitoring or documentation to reduce repeat incidents. Support projects such as office expansions, network upgrades, or cloud connectivity work. How You Will Grow and Make an Impact At Model N, our competency model helps us talk about growth, impact, and how work gets done. People Leadership – You take ownership of your development and apply feedback, such as asking senior engineers to review your configurations and acting on their input. Problem-Solving Leadership – You solve routine problems independently using standard approaches, such as isolating a DNS or VPN fault during an outage. Thought Leadership – You apply growing knowledge to contribute informed ideas, such as noticing a recurring performance issue and sharing the pattern with the team. Entrepreneurial Leadership – You take initiative to improve your work, such as documenting a fix so the team can reuse it. Operational Leadership – You consistently manage your work and priorities to deliver reliable results, such as meeting incident response timelines. AI Leadership – You use AI tools to improve efficiency and quality, such as drafting configuration checks or troubleshooting runbooks. We do not expect every person to be perfect in every area. We look for strong fundamentals, curiosity, ownership, and the ability to keep growing. Qualifications Required Typically 2-4 years of relevant experience. Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including OSI and TCP/IP models, IPv4, subnetting, routing, switching, VLANs, and TCP/UDP protocols. Good understanding of routing concepts and protocols, including static routing and BGP. Hands-on experience or strong working knowledge of enterprise network infrastructure, including switches, routers, firewalls, and wireless networks. Good understanding of network security concepts, including firewalls, ACLs, NAT, IPsec VPNs, and network segmentation. Working knowledge of DNS, DHCP, ARP, ICMP, and network troubleshooting tools such as Ping, Traceroute, Nslookup, Dig, and Wireshark. Good understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPC, subnets, route tables, Internet Gateway, NAT Gateway, Security Groups, NACLs, Private link and VPN connectivity. Experience with network monitoring tools and incident/change management processes. Ability to troubleshoot network connectivity issues methodically and work independently as well as part of a team. Demonstrated experience using generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Gemini) to improve productivity, decision-making, or problem solving in a professional or personal context. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Key skills: Network Administration & Troubleshooting · Cloud Network & Network Security Preferred Relevant certifications, such as CCNA or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate Experience with hybrid cloud connectivity. Familiarity with Zscaler ZIA/ZPA Scripting experience, such as Python or Terraform, for network automation. Interest in leveraging AI, automation, or modern technologies to improve outcomes. How We Work Our DARE core values - D REAM , A LIGN , R ESPECT, and E XCEL - shape how we work together. We solve practical problems that matter to our customers and teams. We work across functions and value clear, respectful communication. We recognize good work and support growth over time. We are curious about better ways to work, including thoughtful use of AI and modern tools. We do not expect every person to be perfect in every area. We look for strong fundamentals, curiosity, ownership, and the ability to keep growing. Compensation, Benefits, and Inclusion At Model N, your well-being and growth matter. We offer a competitive total rewards package designed to support employees personally and professionally. Benefits and compensation for this position will be provided in accordance with Model N’s India programs and applicable local requirements. Bring Your N Factor We are not just looking for a checklist of skills. We are looking for people who bring ideas, curiosity, and a point of view. If this role sounds interesting and you can see yourself adding value, we would love to hear from you. About Model N Model N is transforming how Life Sciences companies manage revenue, commercialization, and compliance. For more than 25 years, Model N has been the leader in end-to-end commercialization, revenue optimization, and compliance for pharmaceutical and medical technology companies. Our intelligent, cloud-based platform combines technology, data, analytics, AI, and industry expertise to help leading Life Sciences organizations optimize revenue, navigate complex regulations, improve decision-making, and bring life-changing products to market faster. Today, 150+ leading companies across the globe trust Model N to optimize growth and transform critical commercial processes. Our solutions manage approximately $1.3 trillion in gross revenue , helping customers reduce complexity, strengthen compliance, and unlock new opportunities for growth. At Model N, we are building the next generation of Life Sciences revenue management —where technology, data, AI, and human expertise come together to create meaningful business impact. Join us to build technology that powers innovation in Life Sciences and makes a difference at global scale. For more information, visit www.modeln.com. title: Software Engineer
description: Who Are We? Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster. The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman. P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman. About the Team The Identity and Access Management team is responsible for building a secure, reliable, and seamless identity platform for all Postman users. This team owns the systems behind authentication, session management, access control, service accounts, invites, and other foundational identity capabilities that power the product. Postman’s identity layer is a critical part of the product experience. It sits on the path of every authenticated request and enables users, teams, and systems to access Postman securely and collaborate effectively. The team works on a mix of core platform improvements, new product capabilities, and reliability/security investments. What You’ll Do Build and maintain backend systems that power Postman’s identity and authentication platform. Work with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to scope, implement, test, and launch new features and platform improvements. Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services and APIs. Improve system quality by writing tests, fixing bugs, and strengthening observability and monitoring. Participate in production support, debugging, incident investigation, and follow-through on fixes. Work on performance, scalability, and reliability improvements for the services owned by the team. Take ownership of well-defined projects and components, and drive them with support from senior engineers and your manager. Contribute to code reviews and team discussions, and adopt strong software engineering practices. Collaborate with other engineers to break down work, resolve ambiguity, and deliver iteratively. About You You have 2+ years of experience building backend or distributed systems in production environments. You have a solid foundation in software engineering fundamentals such as data structures, algorithms, networking, and system design basics. You are comfortable writing clean, testable, maintainable code. You have experience working with backend services, APIs, and databases. You are able to work through ambiguity with guidance and ask the right questions to move work forward. You care about quality, reliability, and learning how systems behave in production. You collaborate well with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders. You have good written and verbal communication skills. You are curious, eager to learn, and motivated to grow in a platform engineering environment. Technical Experience We Value Experience with backend technologies such as Node.js, Java, Python, Go, or Ruby Familiarity with distributed systems and cloud infrastructure Experience building or maintaining microservices and APIs Familiarity with databases, caching, queues, or event-driven systems Exposure to testing, monitoring, debugging, and production support Familiarity with authentication, authorization, identity, RBAC, access control, or security-sensitive systems is a plus, but not required What Else? In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves. At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom. Our Values At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can. Equal Opportunity Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. description: About Snaphomz Snaphomz is an AI-powered real estate platform helping buyers, sellers, and agents navigate the home buying and selling journey in the US. We bring together property search, market insights, personalized recommendations, and transaction workflows to help people make informed decisions. About the role We’re looking for a Senior Data Engineer to own the pipelines and data infrastructure behind our platform. You will integrate property listings and third-party data, build reliable datasets, and make accurate, timely information available to our product, analytics, and AI systems. This is a hands-on role with responsibility for architecture, implementation, production reliability, and mentoring. What you’ll do - Design, build, and maintain batch and near-real-time pipelines for property listings, market data, user activity, and transaction workflows. - Integrate MLS feeds, real estate APIs, and other external sources, handling incremental updates, schema changes, rate limits, retries, and backfills. - Build consistent data models across properties, listings, agents, users, and transactions. - Implement validation, deduplication, address normalization, entity matching, and data reconciliation. - Track listing changes and maintain reliable historical records, including price changes, status updates, and removed listings. - Develop curated datasets for conversational property search, recommendations, affordability tools, and analytics. - Improve database performance, pipeline efficiency, and infrastructure costs. - Establish monitoring and alerts for pipeline failures, stale data, missing records, and unexpected volume changes. - Apply source-specific access, retention, and display requirements throughout the data lifecycle. - Work with backend engineers, data scientists, and product teams to define data contracts and deliver production-ready solutions. - Maintain documentation, deployment workflows, and incident runbooks; mentor other engineers. Nice to have - Experience with real estate data, MLS integrations, RESO Web API, or property data providers. - Experience with geospatial data, PostGIS, address matching, or geographic search. - Familiarity with Neo4j, search indexes, vector databases, or data pipelines supporting AI applications. - Experience with dbt, Spark, Kafka, or comparable tools where scale requires them. - Experience handling sensitive user data and implementing access controls and audit trails. What success looks like Within your first 90 days, you will understand our data sources and architecture, improve the reliability and visibility of critical pipelines, establish measurable data quality and freshness checks, and deliver a production data integration or significant pipeline improvement.
